summary.text: Dana Traversie is the Republican candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the September 9, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Dana Traversie previously ran for Rhode Island House District 23 in 2022, winning the Republican primary and then losing the general election to incumbent Democrat K. Joseph Shekarchi, who received 59.9 percent of the vote to his 40.0 percent.
